verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no SigNoz-native capability for setting up autonomous background automations or agents. The closest items are related but different: alerts that send notifications (an adjacent monitoring feature), service accounts for external automation scripts (a developer building block), and MCP/Agent Skills for externally driven AI assistants. None of these count as the product running automations autonomously on the user's behalf.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
